```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(targets)
library(tidyverse)
library(Seurat)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(DT)

source(file.path("src/R/scrna-seq_utilities.R"))

COND_PAL <- c(WT = "#1f78b4", "mCh-" = "#a6cee3", "mCh+" = "#e31a1c")
COND_ORDER <- c("WT", "mCh-", "mCh+")
```

```{r load}
tar_load(scenic_auc_mat_hsc_full)      # cells × regulons  (full cohort)
tar_load(scenic_meta_hsc)              # cell_id, UMAP1/2, sample.name, condition, cluster col
tar_load(scenic_agg_column)            # cluster column name used for AUC aggregation
tar_load(scenic_agg_hsc_full)          # clusters × regulons
tar_load(scenic_prop_mat_hsc_full)     # clusters × conditions proportion matrix
tar_load(scenic_hclust_rows_hsc_full)  # regulon row dendrogram
tar_load(scenic_hclust_cols_hsc_full)  # cluster column dendrogram
tar_load(scenic_cutree_rows_hsc_full)  # named int: regulon → row group

# convenience aliases so the rest of the notebook code is unchanged
scenic_auc_mat_hsc     <- scenic_auc_mat_hsc_full
scenic_agg_hsc         <- scenic_agg_hsc_full
scenic_prop_mat_hsc    <- scenic_prop_mat_hsc_full
scenic_hclust_rows_hsc <- scenic_hclust_rows_hsc_full
scenic_hclust_cols_hsc <- scenic_hclust_cols_hsc_full
scenic_cutree_rows_hsc <- scenic_cutree_rows_hsc_full
rm(scenic_auc_mat_hsc_full, scenic_agg_hsc_full, scenic_prop_mat_hsc_full,
   scenic_hclust_rows_hsc_full, scenic_hclust_cols_hsc_full, scenic_cutree_rows_hsc_full)
```

---

# 1 · Regulon summary

```{r regulon-summary}
auc_stats <- tibble(
  regulon  = colnames(scenic_auc_mat_hsc),
  TF       = sub("\\([+-]\\)$", "", colnames(scenic_auc_mat_hsc)),
  mean_AUC = colMeans(scenic_auc_mat_hsc),
  sd_AUC   = apply(scenic_auc_mat_hsc, 2, sd),
  max_AUC  = apply(scenic_auc_mat_hsc, 2, max)
) |>
  arrange(desc(mean_AUC))

datatable(
  auc_stats |> mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 4))),
  rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
  caption  = sprintf("%d regulons sorted by mean AUC", nrow(auc_stats)),
  options  = list(pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE)
)
```

---

# 2 · Cell UMAP

HSC UMAP (SCT embedding) coloured by cluster and condition. Cluster labels are
placed at median centroids.

```{r umap-clusters, fig.width=13, fig.height=5}
umap_cl <- scenic_meta_hsc |>
  dplyr::select(cell_id, UMAP1, UMAP2,
                cluster = dplyr::all_of(scenic_agg_column),
                condition) |>
  dplyr::mutate(cluster = factor(cluster))

centroids <- umap_cl |>
  dplyr::group_by(cluster) |>
  dplyr::summarise(UMAP1 = median(UMAP1), UMAP2 = median(UMAP2), .groups = "drop")

p_clust <- ggplot(umap_cl, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.15, alpha = 0.35) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data          = centroids,
    aes(label     = cluster),
    colour        = "black",
    fill          = alpha("white", 0.75),
    size          = 3.5, fontface = "bold",
    label.size    = 0.25,
    label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines"),
    min.segment.length = 0, seed = 42, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(
    title = "Cluster",
    override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)
  )) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

p_cond <- ggplot(umap_cl, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = condition)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.15, alpha = 0.35) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = COND_PAL, na.value = "grey80", name = NULL) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1))) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

p_clust + p_cond + patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(1.1, 1))
```

---

# 3 · AUC heatmap (z-scored per regulon)

Mean AUC per regulon per cluster (z-scored within each regulon). Rows and
columns use pre-computed Ward.D2 dendrograms. The condition mix bar shows
the proportion of WT / mCh− / mCh+ cells per cluster.

```{r heatmap}
#| fig-height: 16
#| fig-width: 14
heat_mat <- t(scale(scenic_agg_hsc))   # regulons × clusters, z-scored

col_ann <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  `Condition mix` = anno_barplot(
    scenic_prop_mat_hsc,
    ylim = c(0, 1), bar_width = 0.9,
    gp = gpar(fill = COND_PAL[COND_ORDER], col = NA),
    axis_param = list(side = "left", gp = gpar(fontsize = 7))
  ),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  annotation_name_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 8)
)

draw(
  Heatmap(
    heat_mat,
    name                 = "z-score\nmean AUC",
    col                  = colorRamp2(c(-2.5, 0, 2.5), c("#2166ac", "white", "#b2182b")),
    top_annotation       = col_ann,
    cluster_rows         = as.dendrogram(scenic_hclust_rows_hsc),
    cluster_columns      = as.dendrogram(scenic_hclust_cols_hsc),
    row_split            = length(unique(scenic_cutree_rows_hsc)),
    column_names_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 7),
    row_labels           = sub("\\([+-]\\)$", "", rownames(heat_mat)),
    row_names_gp         = gpar(fontsize = 4),
    border               = FALSE,
    column_title         = sprintf("%d clusters", ncol(heat_mat)),
    column_title_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 9),
    row_title_gp         = gpar(fontsize = 8),
    heatmap_legend_param = list(direction = "vertical")
  ),
  heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right"
)
```

# 4 · Top regulon UMAPs

Top 16 regulons by mean AUC projected onto the HSC UMAP.

```{r umap-prep}
top16 <- auc_stats$regulon[seq_len(min(16, nrow(auc_stats)))]

shared_cells <- intersect(rownames(scenic_auc_mat_hsc), scenic_meta_hsc$cell_id)
umap_df <- scenic_meta_hsc[match(shared_cells, scenic_meta_hsc$cell_id),
                            c("cell_id","UMAP1","UMAP2","sample.name","condition")] |>
  dplyr::bind_cols(
    as.data.frame(scenic_auc_mat_hsc[shared_cells, top16, drop = FALSE])
  )
```

```{r umap-top16, fig.height=16, fig.width=16}
plot_reg_umap <- function(reg, df) {
  df |>
    dplyr::arrange(.data[[reg]]) |>
    ggplot(aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = .data[[reg]])) +
    geom_point(size = 0.2, alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_colour_gradientn(
      colours = c("#f0f0f0", "#feb24c", "#f03b20", "#bd0026"),
      name = "AUC"
    ) +
    labs(title = sub("\\([+-]\\)$", "", reg)) +
    theme_void(base_size = 9) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9, hjust = 0.5),
          legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm"),
          legend.text  = element_text(size = 6),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 7))
}

patchwork::wrap_plots(lapply(top16, plot_reg_umap, df = umap_df), ncol = 4)
```

```{r umap-sample, fig.height=4, fig.width=10}
umap_df |>
  ggplot(aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = condition)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.15, alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = COND_PAL, name = NULL) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1))) +
  labs(title = "Condition") +
  theme_void(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```


# 5 · SCENIC UMAP — regulon-activity embedding

PCA (centred, not scaled) on the full regulon AUC matrix, followed by UMAP.
This produces a cell layout driven purely by transcription-factor activity rather
than gene expression, allowing comparison with the SCT-based embedding.

```{r scenic-umap-build}
tar_load(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)
tar_load(scenic_assay_hsc)   # Assay5 object: regulons × cells (pre-built in pipeline)

# Add pre-built SCENIC assay and set as default
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc[["SCENIC"]] <- scenic_assay_hsc
rm(scenic_assay_hsc); gc()
DefaultAssay(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc) <- "SCENIC"

# Centre without scaling: PCA should capture activity variation, not be
# dominated by mean-level differences between regulons.
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc <- Seurat::ScaleData(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
                                              assay = "SCENIC", 
                                              features = rownames(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc[["SCENIC"]]),
                             do.scale = TRUE,
                             do.center = TRUE, 
                             verbose = FALSE)

# PCA — use all regulons as features
n_reg <- nrow(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc[["SCENIC"]])
n_pcs <- min(50L, n_reg - 1L)
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc <- Seurat::RunPCA(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
                          assay          = "SCENIC",
                         features = rownames(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc[["SCENIC"]]),
                          npcs           = n_pcs,
                          reduction.name = "pca_scenic",
                          reduction.key  = "scenicPC_",
                          verbose        = FALSE)

mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc <- Seurat::FindNeighbors(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
                                dims            = 1:n_pcs,
                                reduction       = "pca_scenic",
                                k.param         = 30,
                                compute.SNN     = TRUE,
                                graph.name      = paste0("neighbors_", "pca_scenic", "_", 30),
                                return.neighbor = TRUE)
# UMAP on the scenic PCA
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc <- Seurat::RunUMAP(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
                                            n.neighbors = 30,
                                            nn.name = "neighbors_pca_scenic_30",
                                            reduction.name = "umap_nn_scenic",
                                            reduction.key  = "scenicUMAP_",
                                            verbose        = FALSE)

```

# 6 · Regulon Specificity Score (RSS)

RSS measures how specifically each regulon's AUC activity is concentrated in
a given cell group. RSS = 1 − √JSD(regulon distribution ∥ group distribution),
where JSD is the Jensen-Shannon divergence. Higher scores indicate that the
regulon is preferentially active in that group.

```{r rss-setup}
# Align AUC matrix to cells present in scenic_meta_hsc
rss_cells <- intersect(rownames(scenic_auc_mat_hsc), scenic_meta_hsc$cell_id)
rss_auc   <- scenic_auc_mat_hsc[rss_cells, , drop = FALSE]
rss_anno  <- scenic_meta_hsc |>
  dplyr::select(cell_id, sample.name, condition) |>
  dplyr::filter(cell_id %in% rss_cells)

# Cluster annotation — same column used for AUC aggregation in the heatmap
clust_anno <- setNames(
  scenic_meta_hsc[[scenic_agg_column]][match(rss_cells, scenic_meta_hsc$cell_id)],
  rss_cells
)
clust_col <- scenic_agg_column
```

## By condition

```{r rss-condition, fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
cond_anno <- setNames(rss_anno$condition, rss_anno$cell_id)

rss_cond <- calc_rss(rss_auc, cond_anno)
plot_rss(rss_cond, top_n = 10) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "Top 10 regulons per condition")
```

```{r rss-condition-rank}
tf_auc_mean <- GetAssayData(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, "SCENIC", layer = "data") %>%
  rowMeans() %>%
  enframe(name = "tf", value = "mean_auc")
top_n <- 15
rank_plt_df <- rss_cond %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("tf") %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -tf, names_to = "condition",
                 values_to = "rss") %>%
    group_by(condition) %>%
    mutate(r = rank(rss),
           top_tf = r > (dplyr::n() - top_n)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
  left_join(tf_auc_mean)

rank_plt_df %>%
    ggplot(aes(r, rss)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = mean_auc), size = 0.8, alpha = 0.6) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
        data              = . %>% filter(top_tf),
        mapping           = aes(label = tf, color = mean_auc),
        size              = 3,
        max.overlaps      = 20,
        min.segment.length = 0,
        segment.size      = 0.2,
        segment.color     = scales::alpha("grey50", 0.5),
        nudge_x           = -200,
        direction         = "y",
        hjust             = 1
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~condition) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo") +
    theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 20))
```

```{r rss-condition-heatmap}
#| fig-height: 16
#| fig-width: 14
pheatmap(rss_cond, scale = "row", fontsize_row = 3)
```

## By cluster

```{r rss-cluster, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
rss_clust <- calc_rss(rss_auc, clust_anno)
plot_rss(rss_clust, top_n = 5) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = sprintf("Top 5 regulons per cluster (%s)", clust_col))
```

## By sample.name

One `plot_rss()` panel per sample, patchworked into a grid.
Each panel shows the top regulons within that sample's cells only —
capturing sample-level idiosyncrasies in TF activity beyond the
condition-level signal.

```{r rss-per-sample, fig.height=20, fig.width=18}
samples     <- sort(unique(rss_anno$sample.name))
sample_anno <- setNames(rss_anno$sample.name, rss_anno$cell_id)

rss_per_sample <- lapply(setNames(samples, samples), function(smp) {
  smp_cells <- rss_anno$cell_id[rss_anno$sample.name == smp]
  calc_rss(rss_auc[smp_cells, , drop = FALSE], clust_anno[smp_cells])
})

rss_plots <- lapply(samples, function(smp) {
  plot_rss(rss_per_sample[[smp]], top_n = 5, min_rss = 0) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = smp) +
    ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))
})

patchwork::wrap_plots(rss_plots, ncol = 2) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    title    = "Top 5 regulons per cluster — per sample",
    subtitle = "Rows show regulons; columns show clusters present in that sample",
    theme    = ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"))
  )
```

```{r rss-cleanup, include=FALSE}
rm(scenic_auc_mat_hsc, scenic_meta_hsc, rss_auc, rss_anno, rss_cells,
   clust_anno, cond_anno, rss_clust, rss_cond, rss_per_sample, rss_plots,
   samples, sample_anno); gc()
```
